notes_for_editor: Three sources agree on the c.1927 camp, the 1931 cab and the 1957 destruction. No source gives a cause of destruction, staff names or the site's condition today. The 'Ruins' label on firelookout.com sits next to the Brush Hill patrol tower, so it is not applied to the summit site. Brush Hill may have its own record (us-id-brush-hill, status ruins) to cross-check. The sources do not say whether the 1931 cab stood at ground level, so the 'ground' kind is left as recorded.
